name: Horocope
tagline: The stars knew everything. They just didn't tell you.
description: Horocope is a daily horoscope for crypto traders. Every morning an AI agent reads the last 24 hours of the Solana market and the real positions of the planets, and writes twelve entries. It was never your fault. No wallet is connected.

hero.text: Reads the market. Blames the stars. Every morning an AI agent reads the last 24 hours of Solana and the real sky of the day, and writes a horoscope for twelve signs. It was never your fault.

about.title: Madame Cope sees everything. She is very sorry.
text: Madame Cope is a crystal ball in a blue turban. She has watched every chart since the first one and has never once blamed a trader.
Each morning she reads what the market did while you slept, looks up at the real sky, finds the planet responsible and writes twelve short entries. Then she hands you a tissue.
She is an AI agent. She works alone, on a schedule. Nobody presses a button.

steps.title: She wakes up by herself
steps.text: Every day at 06:00 UTC a scheduled job starts the agent. No visitor triggers it and no wallet is involved.

steps.title: She reads the market and the sky
steps.text: The agent picks its own readings: the move of SOL, the biggest winners and losers, the newest tokens. The sky is the real one: where every planet stands today, who is retrograde, the phase of the Moon. Every number is computed by code.

steps.title: She writes the issue
steps.text: A headline, the sky of the day and twelve entries. For each sign the code finds the planet that really stands against it today and gives the day a score, then the market moves the score up or down. The words are hers.

steps.title: The issue goes into the journal
steps.text: It is stored, shown here and kept in the archive. You pick a sign, read the entry and take the card.

rules.title: House rules
items: This is a joke about yesterday. It is not a forecast and it is not financial advice.
The horoscope never tells you what to buy, sell or hold. If it seems to, a planet is confusing you.
An AI agent writes the words once a day. It can be wrong. The numbers come from public market data and are computed by code.
The sky is real: the positions of the planets, the retrogrades and the phase of the Moon are computed for the date. What they mean for your trades is a joke.
Tokens are never named in an issue. The agent sees numbers, not names.
The site asks for no wallet and sends nothing about you to the server. Your sign and your birthday stay in your browser.
Astrology is entertainment here. Madame Cope is a crystal ball. For anything important, consult a human.

sample.headline: Venus walks backwards. None of it was you.
sky: SOL lost 6.4 percent in a day, and 27 of the 38 tokens Madame Cope read went red.
Venus is retrograde in Scorpio. She turned around and the market followed her out.
sample.closing: It was written long before you opened the chart.

signs.why: Saturn is retrograde in Aries, in your sign
signs.text: Saturn is retrograde in your sign, walking backwards through your living room. SOL fell 6.4 percent and you were home for it. He will leave. You may stay.

signs.why: Venus, the ruler of Taurus, is retrograde in Scorpio
signs.text: Venus rules you, and she has turned retrograde in Scorpio. One token fell 81 percent while she had her back to you. Nobody was at the wheel, dear. Here is a tissue.

signs.why: The Moon is in Virgo, square to your sign
signs.text: The Moon is in Virgo, square to your sign, which is why 27 of 38 tokens looked red to you. They were red for everyone. You only noticed first.

signs.why: Saturn is retrograde in Aries, square to your sign
signs.text: Saturn is retrograde in Aries, square to Cancer. He checked your plan against a day when SOL lost 6.4 percent. The plan was fine. The day was wrong.

signs.why: Mars is in Leo, in your sign
signs.text: Mars is in Leo, in your own sign, pressing buttons. One token rose 182 percent and it was not the one he chose. Forgive him. He means well and reads nothing.

signs.why: Uranus is retrograde in Gemini, square to your sign
signs.text: Uranus is retrograde in Gemini, square to Virgo. 14 of the 20 newest tokens were born in one hour and none of them had a plan. You did. It shows.

signs.why: Saturn is retrograde in Aries, opposite your sign
signs.text: Saturn is retrograde in Aries, directly opposite your sign. Yesterday you bought the very top and he watched from across the sky. He could have said something.

signs.why: Mars is in Leo, square to your sign
signs.text: Mars is in Leo, square to Scorpio, and Venus is walking backwards through your sign. 27 red charts out of 38. With guests like these, nobody blames the host.

signs.why: The Moon is in Virgo, square to your sign
signs.text: The Moon is in Virgo, square to your sign, and still 11 tokens went green near you. A decent day, which is suspicious. Enjoy it quietly.

signs.why: Saturn is retrograde in Aries, square to your sign
signs.text: Saturn, your own ruler, is retrograde in Aries and square to your sign. A token two days old fell 81 percent on his watch. He has been spoken to.

signs.why: Mars is in Leo, opposite your sign
signs.text: Mars is in Leo, opposite Aquarius, and he was shouting. SOL lost 6.4 percent while you tried to think. It was loud in there. You did what you could.

signs.why: The Moon is in Virgo, opposite your sign
signs.text: The Moon is in Virgo, opposite Pisces, pulling the tide out: 27 charts of 38 went low. Fish feel it first. It was the tide, darling. It always is.

notes.text: Let me look at the sky, dear.
Looked at the market: SOL -6.4% in 24 hours, 27 red and 11 green of 38 tokens.
Looked up at the real sky: the Moon in Virgo, waning crescent. Retrograde: Venus, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto.
Drew the chart. Planet of the day: Venus. Venus is retrograde in Scorpio.
Something fell a long way. I should see what.
Visited the nursery: 14 of the 20 newest tokens were born in the last hour.
Issue written. Twelve signs, nobody to blame.
